items.title: NASA announces unprecedented return of sick ISS astronaut and crew
items.raw_content: NASA has announced the early return of Crew-11 from the International Space Station after an unidentified astronaut experienced a medical problem.
items.title_zh: NASA 宣布患病 ISS 宇航员及乘组提前返回，史无前例
items.summary: NASA announced that Crew-11 will return early from the International Space Station after an unidentified astronaut experienced a medical problem.

items.title: Meta announces nuclear energy projects
items.raw_content: Our landmark agreements with Vistra, TerraPower, and Oklo will expand the operation of three nuclear power plants, boost the development of nuclear technology, and foster job growth in American communities.
items.title_zh: Meta 宣布核能项目
items.summary: Meta says its agreements with Vistra, TerraPower and Oklo will expand operations at three nuclear power plants, support nuclear technology development and create jobs in American communities.

items.title: Anna's Archive loses .org domain after surprise suspension
items.raw_content: Popular shadow library Anna's Archive has lost control over its main domain name. Annas-archive.org was suspended and put on serverhold status.
items.title_zh: Anna's Archive 在域名突遭暂停后失去 .org 域名
items.summary: Anna's Archive, a widely used shadow library, no longer controls its main domain; annas-archive.org has been suspended and put on serverhold status.

items.title: The U.S. Government Just Followed Through on Its Ban of DJI Drones
items.raw_content: By the time you read this, the widespread embargo on every foreign-made consumer drone will be in effect. That’s essentially all of them.
items.title_zh: 美国政府正式落实对 DJI 无人机的禁令
items.summary: The broad US embargo on foreign-made consumer drones, which covers essentially all of them, is now in effect, according to the report.

items.title: Vietnam bans unskippable ads
items.raw_content: If things go our way, YouTube’s notorious unskippable ads might be a thing of the past come this February. ...
items.title_zh: 越南禁止不可跳过广告
items.summary: A post reports that Vietnam has banned unskippable ads, saying YouTube's unskippable ads might be gone as soon as this February if things go as hoped.

items.summary: Users on Reddit have documented what they describe as astroturfing by RevisionDojo, a YC-backed IB test-prep company that raised $3.4M, including coordinated accounts posing as students, paid promotional posts and pressure on critics.

items.summary: Voltair is a San Francisco company founded in 2025 that describes itself as building autonomous drones for Earth observation, with five employees and two open engineering roles.

items.title: Federated Learning and Class Imbalances
items.title_zh: 联邦学习与类别不平衡
items.summary: The paper reproduces RHFL+ and compares it with benchmark algorithms under a unified framework, extends the method to three medical imaging datasets, and implements it with NVIDIA's NVFlare federated learning framework.

items.title: Evaluating Accounting Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型的会计推理能力
items.summary: The authors define vertical-domain accounting reasoning, propose evaluation criteria derived from GLM training-data characteristics, and test GLM-6B, GLM-130B, GLM-4, and OpenAI GPT-4 on accounting tasks. Prompt design significantly affected performance, with GPT-4 strongest, though the models remained insufficient for real-world enterprise accounting.

items.title: Overcoming the Retrieval Barrier: Indirect Prompt Injection in the Wild for LLM Systems
items.title_zh: 跨越检索门槛：LLM 系统中真实场景的间接提示注入
items.summary: Researchers split malicious content into a trigger fragment that guarantees retrieval and an attack fragment carrying the payload, reaching near-100% retrieval across 11 benchmarks and 8 embedding models at costs as low as $0.21 per target query; in one demonstration a single poisoned email led GPT-4o to exfiltrate SSH keys with over 80% success in a multi-agent workflow.

items.title: A Foundation Model Approach for Fetal Stress Prediction During Labor From cardiotocography (CTG) recordings
items.title_zh: 基于胎心监护（CTG）记录的产时胎儿应激预测基础模型方法
items.summary: The authors apply self-supervised pre-training to intrapartum CTG analysis, using 2,444 hours of unlabeled recordings and fine-tuning on the 552-recording CTU-UHB benchmark with a PatchTST transformer; they report an AUROC of 0.83 on the full test set and release dataset splits and model weights.

items.title: Toward Maturity-Based Certification of Embodied AI: Quantifying Trustworthiness Through Measurement Mechanisms
items.title_zh: 迈向基于成熟度的具身 AI 认证：通过测量机制量化可信度
items.summary: The paper proposes a maturity-based framework for certifying embodied AI systems through explicit measurement mechanisms, combining structured assessment and quantitative scoring to handle trustworthiness trade-offs. It illustrates the approach with uncertainty quantification in an uncrewed aircraft system detection case study.

items.title: Large Language Models Are Bad Dice Players: LLMs Struggle to Generate Random Numbers from Statistical Distributions
items.title_zh: 大语言模型不会掷骰子：LLM 难以按统计分布生成随机数
items.summary: The authors run a large-scale audit of native probabilistic sampling in 11 frontier LLMs across 15 distributions, finding a 7% median pass rate for batch generation and near-total failure for independent requests, where 10 of 11 models passed no distribution. They conclude that current LLMs lack a functional internal sampler and need external tools when statistical guarantees are required.

items.title: Behavioral Analytics for Continuous Insider Threat Detection in Zero-Trust Architectures
items.title_zh: 零信任架构中用于持续内部威胁检测的行为分析
items.summary: The paper proposes a behavioral-analytics framework for continuous insider-threat detection in zero-trust architectures, using the CERT Insider Threat Dataset with SMOTE, PCA, and an AdaBoost classifier benchmarked against SVM, ANN, and Bayesian networks. AdaBoost reported 98.0% accuracy and an AUC of 0.98, above the comparison models.

items.title: SDUs DAISY: A Benchmark for Danish Culture
items.title_zh: SDU 的 DAISY：丹麦文化基准测试
items.summary: Daisy is a factual-knowledge benchmark built from the Danish Culture Canon 2006 with 741 manually verified closed-ended question-answer pairs; contemporary models performed poorly, with the best, Llama-3.3-70B, reaching only 0.17 BLEU and 0.27 F1.
